request.state: Incident 4471 timeline. 09:02 deploy of checkout-api build 8812 starts in us-east-2. 09:06 p99 latency on /cart rises from 180 ms to 2.4 s; error rate 0.2% to 6%. 09:07 on-call paged by the latency alarm. 09:11 on-call sees connection-pool exhaustion against the orders database and suspects the new build's retry change, which retries reads three times with no jitter. 09:14 rollback to build 8807 started. 09:19 rollback complete in two of three cells; the third cell is still on 8812 because its deployment was paused by a separate change freeze. 09:23 p99 back to 210 ms in the rolled-back cells; the third cell keeps failing about 9% of requests. 09:31 the freeze owner approves the rollback for the third cell. 09:38 all cells healthy. Customer impact: about 36 minutes of degraded checkout in one region, an estimated 2,100 failed carts. The retry change had passed load tests, which ran against a database with three times the production connection limit. No runbook step covered a cell stuck behind a freeze.
